brief.aim: This is a transactional retail log with no plausible outcome column, so the natural aim is segmenting customers into behavioral groups from aggregated purchase features (recency, frequency, monetary value, product mix); timestamps are used only to build static features relative to an observation date, so no chronology column is set.
brief.repeated_subjects: Each customer contributes many invoice lines across many invoices and dates, so customers repeat heavily.
brief.unit: Customer (CustomerID) aggregated from its invoice line items
